sara_cs: FYI — ran into a weird one during onboarding: Android SDK clients get 403 on subsequent requests right after we rotate their API key. Works for web clients.

dan_eng: any logs or a repro? 403 message?

sara_cs: Logs show: 
```
ERROR auth: token exchange failed: 403 invalid_token
req: POST /v1/generate tenant=acme-mobile-01
headers: Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
```

maria_infra: are they behind any CDN or edge cache? sometimes proxies naively cache Authorization responses.

sara_cs: Yes — CloudFront in front of their mobile backend. Preflight /v1/init (POST) returns 200, but generate -> 403. Suspicion: old token cached or race during rotation.

kevin_support: Quick checks: 1) confirm key rotation propagation time, 2) ask customer to verify their client is fetching new token (no local pinning), 3) confirm CloudFront rule isn't caching auth header.

dan_eng: Also: we have a rotation_grace_seconds config but it's off by default for hosted tenants. I can enable a short tolerance window for this tenant to smooth handover.

sara_cs: Can we avoid telling customer to flush CDN? they'd prefer we handle server-side.

dan_eng: I'll flip rotation_tolerance for acme-mobile-01 to 120s (2m) — that will accept tokens issued up to 2m before rotation, and add Cache-Control: no-cache on auth endpoints in responses. Doing it now.

maria_infra: FYI I pushed a CloudFront config note to the onboarding checklist: set forwarded headers to include Authorization and set minimum TTL=0 for auth routes.

sara_cs: Tenant ID: acme-mobile-01. Thanks.

dan_eng: toggled rotation_tolerance=true for tenant acme-mobile-01 and added response header patch for /v1/init: Cache-Control: no-cache,stale-while-revalidate=0. Watch logs for failures.

sara_cs: customer reports Android app now receives 200 on generates. I see no 403s in last 2 minutes. Will close the ticket and send postmortem notes + docs. :tada:

kevin_support: Follow-up action: update onboarding guide to call out CDN header forwarding and add a small FAQ for key rotation edgecases.

sara_cs: I'll draft the doc and paste it here for review later.
